content.title: About
content.content: Energy Drink XS is a non‑alcoholic beverage containing caffeine, taurine, B‑vitamins and sugar (or sugar substitutes). It is designed to boost alertness, improve concentration and temporarily increase physical endurance. The product is sold in 250 ml aluminum cans.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first energy drink was launched in Japan in the 1960s, while XS entered the market in 2018.
XS provides 80 mg of caffeine, roughly equivalent to one espresso shot.
The formula includes vitamins B3, B5, B6 and B12, which support energy metabolism.
It has a fruity‑citrus flavor with hints of passion‑fruit berries.
XS is marketed as a low‑sugar option: the regular version contains 6 g of sugar, the diet version is sugar‑free.

items.title: Increased alertness
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, reducing feelings of fatigue and enhancing reaction time.

items.title: Metabolic support
items.content: B‑vitamins help convert carbohydrates, fats and proteins into usable energy.

items.title: Improved focus
items.content: Taurine may aid brain function and lessen mental “fog.”

items.title: Electrolyte balance
items.content: Small amounts of sodium and potassium help maintain fluid balance during exercise.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: Vitamin B6 possesses antioxidant properties that protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Individuals sensitive to caffeine may experience anxiety, rapid heartbeat, and sleep disturbances.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The regular version contains sugar, which can contribute to weight gain and increase the risk of dental caries if consumed frequently.

items.title: Drug interactions
items.content: Caffeine can amplify the effects of certain stimulants and reduce the efficacy of sedative medications.

items.title: Not for children and pregnant women
items.content: Due to its high caffeine level, the drink is not recommended for people under 18, pregnant or nursing women.

items.title: Potential dehydration risk
items.content: During intense workouts the drink does not replace water and may contribute to fluid loss.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Consume one can (250 ml) 30–60 minutes before physical or mental activity. Do not exceed two cans per day. Do not mix with alcohol.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the can in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, it is best consumed within 24 hours.
